author: Λουκάς Σταμέλλος
title: Ο αντεισαγγελέας ΑΠ Βασίλης Φλωρίδης γίνεται το πρόσωπο της διαφθοράς
content:
Σύνδεσμος δημοσίευσης:

Ο αντεισαγγελέας ΑΠ Βασίλης Φλωρίδης γίνεται το πρόσωπο της διαφθοράς


Ο Βασίλης Φλωρίδης, αντεισαγγελέας Αρείου Πάγου και αδελφός του υπουργού Δικαιοσύνης Γιώργου Φλωρίδη,

δημοσίευσε στην «Καθημερινή» ένα «άρθρο»

 με το οποίο

πέρασε γενεές δεκατέσσαρες τους υφισταμένους του εισαγγελείς


και τα δικαστικά συμβούλια

 γιατί έστειλαν σε δίκη – που

επίκειται

 να φτάσει στο ακροατήριο – 11 άτομα, μεταξύ των οποίων υψηλόβαθμους αξιωματικούς και τον τότε αρχηγό της ΕΛ.ΑΣ.


Το αντικείμενο αυτής της δικογραφίας; Η απόπειρα συγκάλυψης της σύλληψης του γιου του υπουργού (τότε Προστασίας του Πολίτη και νυν Ανάπτυξης) Τάκη Θεοδωρικάκου τον Νοέμβριο του 2021. Η ίδια η σύλληψη μικρή σημασία είχε, καθώς επρόκειτο για το γελοίο «αδίκημα» της κατοχής μικρής ποσότητας κάνναβης. Αυτό που έχει σημασία είναι ότι, κατά τη δικογραφία, φέρεται να κινητοποιήθηκαν «λυτοί και δεμένοι» για να μη γίνει σύλληψη του γιου του υπουργού.

Περισσότερα για την παραπομπή των κατηγορουμένων μπορείτε να διαβάσετε εδώ

.


Με λίγα λόγια, για να γίνει κατανοητό το μέγεθος της ωμής παρέμβασης:


Aδελφός υπουργού χρησιμοποιεί την επιρροή της θεσμικής του ιδιότητας

για να προκαταλάβει το αποτέλεσμα


επικείμενης


ποινικής δίκης

 που αντιμετωπίζει ο γιος ενός άλλου υπουργού. Κι αυτό συνέβη μέσω μιας εφημερίδας – πυλώνα της ελληνικής Δεξιάς, με μεγάλη απήχηση στους δικαστικούς κύκλους.


Η παρέμβαση του Βασίλη Φλωρίδη δεν σχολιάζει κάποια γενικά χαρακτηριστικά υποθέσεων τα οποία δεν μπορούν να συνδεθούν με συγκεκριμένη δικογραφία. Δίνει ουσιαστικά «γραμμή» στους δικαστές που θα κρίνουν την υπόθεση. Κι αυτό το κάνει σχολιάζοντας την ουσία του σκεπτικού των υφισταμένων του εισαγγελέων, με αμετροέπειες όπως:


Και οι τέσσερις εισαγγελείς που αντιστάθηκαν, κατέγραψαν στα δικαστικά τους κείμενα ένα κοινό βασικό δεδομένο: Οτι τα αποδεικτικά στοιχεία που υποτίθεται θεμελίωναν τα εγκλήματα, ήταν σαθρά και δεν μπορούσαν να στηρίξουν τις κατηγορίες. Στη συγκεκριμένη περίπτωση δεν επρόκειτο για έκφραση κρίσης πίσω από την οποία θα μπορούσε να καλυφθεί ο δικαστής. Ηταν κατασκευή κρίσης.


Ο αντεισαγγελέας του Αρείου Πάγου καταλήγει σε λυρικές περιγραφές για «φλέβες διαφθοράς» που «καταλήγουν στην καρδιά του οργανισμού» και «πόρτα της διαφθοράς» που «ανοίγει πάντα από μέσα».


Όλα αυτά επειδή κάποιοι εισαγγελείς και κάποιοι δικαστές στα συμβούλια

δεν θεώρησαν ότι επειδή πρόκειται για γιο υπουργού πρέπει να κάνουν τα στραβά μάτια

 στην απόπειρα συγκάλυψης.


Ευχολόγια οι αντιδράσεις των δικαστικών


Όπως ήταν αναμενόμενο, η πρωτοφανής (

ναι, ακόμα και για την ελλαδική πραγματικότητα είναι πρωτοφανής μια τόσο ωμή


εξωθεσμική


παρέμβαση εν ενεργεία εισαγγελέα στην εξέλιξη μιας ποινικής δικογραφίας

) ακρότητα του Β. Φλωρίδη έχει προκαλέσει αυτό που τα ΜΜΕ αγαπούν να ονομάζουν «θύελλα αντιδράσεων».


Η

Ένωση Δικαστών και Εισαγγελέων στην ανακοίνωσή της

 υπενθύμισε ότι

«Είναι ο ίδιος εισαγγελικός λειτουργός που

σε


παλαιότερο άρθρο του στο Βήμα


έγραφε ότι “οι δικαστικοί λειτουργοί που έχουν συγγενικά πρόσωπα με ενεργή ενασχόληση στην πολιτική πρέπει να απέχουν από τον χειρισμό υποθέσεων στα οποία εμπλέκονται πολιτικά πρόσωπα –οι τιμιότεροι όλων κι αν είναι”

»

. Στην ίδια ανακοίνωση, ωστόσο, η ΕνΔΕ δεν χάνει την ευκαιρία να επιτεθεί και στους… δικηγόρους, για κάποιο λόγο, παρουσιάζοντας μια ιδιότυπη «θεωρία των δύο άκρων».


Ο ίδιος

ο Άρειος Πάγος με δελτίο Τύπου του

 χαρακτήρισε

«θυμική αντίδραση επικοινωνιακού χαρακτήρα»

 το «άρθρο» του αντεισαγγελέα του, σημειώνοντας:

«Τέτοιες δημοσιεύσεις, που αφορούν εκκρεμή υπόθεση ενώπιον του Α΄


βαθμού δικαιοδοσίας και πρόκειται να εκδικασθεί άμεσα, οι οποίες περιέχουν μομφή και καταγγέλλουν αορίστως τους επιληφθέντες δικαστές ως διεφθαρμένους, εκφεύγουν των ορίων της οποιασδήποτε κριτικής των δικαστικών αποφάσεων και βουλευμάτων και πλήττουν την εμπιστοσύνη των πολιτών στο θεσμό της Δικαιοσύνης

»

.


Πρόταση για πειθαρχική αναφορά από την Εναλλακτική Παρέμβαση


Η Εναλλακτική Παρέμβαση Δικηγόρων Αθήνας, με

επιστολή των συμβούλων της προς το Διοικητικό Συμβούλιο του Δικηγορικού Συλλόγου Αθηνών

 επισημαίνει ότι οι ανακοινώσεις αποτροπιασμού δεν αρκούν:


Είναι προφανές ότι απέναντι σε αυτή την κατάπτωση δεν αρκούν οι ανακοινώσεις, σαν και αυτή που εξέδωσε η Ένωση Δικαστών και Εισαγγελέων, πιθανά δε να λειτουργούν και εκτονωτικά. Η τελευταία, την ώρα που κατηγορεί δικηγόρους και διοργανώνει έστω και αποτυχημένη ημερίδα για «ακραίες συμπεριφορές τους κατά δικαστών», έχει σαστίσει …

author: Natascha Elena Uhlmann
title: Mexico Volkswagen Workers Could Soon Strike
content:
In Mexico, at the world’s largest Volkswagen facility outside of Germany, workers are weighing the risks of a possible strike.


The 6,500 workers build the Jetta, Tiguan, and Taos at the company’s Puebla plant. Their union, SITIAVW, is one of Mexico’s most storied independent unions, and is in the midst of the plant’s annual wage reopener negotiations.


Days before the strike deadline of October 22, the company presented two proposals—offering raises of 7.98 percent and 7.95 percent for a one-year duration—which were rejected by the union. Soon afterwards, the company presented another offer: an 8.24 percent increase, of which 3.59 percent is a one-time payment of 12,000 pesos, equivalent to about $641 U.S. The deal would maintain the yearly salary reopener, a cycle the company had tried to lengthen in previous offers. Workers will vote on the offer on October 28, and could strike the next day if a deal is not reached.


On October 15, workers voted down an offer that  would have provided a 13 percent combined increase to wages and benefits over the next two years. The vote was 3,135 against and 2,452 for.


A month earlier, workers had overwhelmingly voted down the previous offer of a 10 percent combined increase. (The union had been pushing for a 17 percent increase earlier in negotiations.) Days before that first agreement was put to a vote, Volkswagen cut one of three shifts in a segment of the plant that produces the Jetta and the Tiguan. About

800 workers

 lost their jobs,

El Financiero

 reported.


Although the union announced that 611 of the workers—those who did not sign voluntary separation agreements—would be eligible for reinstatement when Volkswagen begins production of its Golf compact car at the Puebla facility next April, the damage was done. 5,925 of the company’s 6,440 eligible voters participated in the ratification vote: of them,

73 percent voted to reject the offer

, in what SITIAVW advisor Willebaldo Gómez Zuppa characterized as an expression of anger at the firings. The deal would have also

pushed the next wage reopener

 to 18 months out instead of the yearly cycle, angering workers.


‘NOT AT OUR EXPENSE’


Workers were also frustrated with the company’s efforts to put off their next wage reopener for 18 months rather than a year. The second offer would have pushed the wage reopener out even further, to two years.


“We are not blind to the delicate crisis facing the German automotive industry, nor are we ignoring the global financial challenges Volkswagen cites,” the union

said

 in a statement in September after workers voted down the first offer. “But let it be heard loud and clear, all the way to Wolfsburg: corporate crises will not be resolved at the expense of the sweat, the rights, and the future of the Mexican working class.”


Volkswagen did not respond to requests for comment. In a statement sent to

La Jornada de Oriente

, VW

said

, "We respect the result of the vote... and at the same time, express our deep worry and disappointment. This agreement represents the greatest viable offer from the company, given current conditions.”


GLOBAL LAYOFFS


In September, VW announced plans to eliminate

50,000 jobs

 globally by 2030, alongside another 50,000 already anticipated cuts—together representing the largest culling of jobs ever by a single automaker.


The company noted in September that its European factories have the capacity to produce

500,000 more vehicles per year

 than it can sell. The industry faces

“enormous pressure”

 due to low cost electric vehicles produced in China, Volkswagen's CEO Oliver ​Blume said at the Paris Motor Show in October.  Its restructuring plan calls for eliminating half the models it produces (the less profitable half).


IG Metall, which represents 120,000 Volkswagen workers in Germany and sits on the company’s supervisory board, agreed to accept the closure of four German plants between 2031 and 2034, telling the

Guardian

 that both labor and management had made concessions to stave off “a dangerous escalation of the conflict.”


Workers at VW's only U.S. assembly plant, in Chattanooga, Tennessee, joined the United Auto Workers in 2024 after years of trying, and ratified their first contract earlier this year. So far the cuts have not affected them.


It remains unclear how many more cuts are expected in Puebla. Since 2012, the plant has cut its workforce by 36 percent,

Milenio reported

author: Ben Smoke
title: Netanyahu and 34 Israelis Have Gone on Trial for Torture of Flotilla Activist
content:
A landmark trial accusing Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu and 34 senior political and military figures of crimes against humanity had its first formal hearing in Istanbul today.


Turkish prosecutors have charged 35 Israeli defendants, including Netanyahu and ministers Itamar Ben-Gvir and Israel Katz, with torture, unlawful deprivation of liberty, aggravated robbery, vessel hijacking and crimes against humanity in relation to last year’s Gaza aid flotilla. They are also accused of genocide in Palestine.


The trial had its first formal hearing this morning following the issuing of arrest warrants in July and Turkish requests for an

Interpol red notice

 in August. Charges are being pursued under

universal jurisdiction

, which allows countries to address international crimes occurring abroad. 


The case focuses primarily on incidents surrounding the

illegal interception of boats

 from the 2025 Global Sumud Flotilla mission. 


On 31 August 2025, more than 50 ships carrying around 500 participants from 44 countries set off from Barcelona to break Israel’s illegal blockade of Gaza and deliver aid to those trapped there.


The flotilla was subject to a number of drone attacks, most notably off the coasts of Tunisia and Greece, before being

illegally intercepted by Israel

 in international waters. Those on board were detained and have accused Israeli forces of subjecting them to human rights abuses including rape, assault, degrading treatment, withholding of medical care and more.


Turkey negotiated the release of hundreds of participants, including a Novara Media contributor, on charter flights to Istanbul, where legal and medical teams gathered evidence of severe mistreatment. 


“This trial is not just about seeking justice for the 101 victims represented in this case; it is a fundamental challenge to the doctrine of impunity,” said the Global Sumud Flotilla legal team. “When states use armed force against unarmed civilians attempting to deliver life-saving relief to a starved population, individuals within that chain of command must face judicial scrutiny.”


The trial in Istanbul comes as prosecutors in Rome, Italy, expand an investigation into Israeli officials for the mistreatment of 50 Italian participants of Global Sumud Flotilla missions. Officials including Ben-Gvir, Katz, IDF chief of staff Eyal Zamir and 11 others are being investigated for suspected torture, kidnapping, personal injury, robbery, property damage and damage causing danger of shipwreck.

author: Kenny Bruno
title: Mafia Diplomacy Will Continue After Kimberly Guilfoyle
content:
Guilfoyle’s mission in Greece — to push fossil fuels — is also playing out in the US with a permitting reform bill.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

Kimberly Guilfoyle is out as U.S. ambassador to Greece. Mainstream media focused on Donald Trump Jr.’s former fiancée’s credit card bill and her penchant for extravagant partying and fashion. The next ambassador might not share those particular foibles, but the real significance of Guilfoyle’s appointment will last. She was what Dexter Filkins, writing in The New Yorker, calls “a new kind of Washington figure, for whom public office serves as a means to extraordinary wealth.” Donald Trump’s almost daughter-in-law was following in the footsteps of his son-in-law.

Jared Kushner does diplomacy and business simultaneously, and he’s getting really rich from it. While Kushner is dispatched to work on Iran and Ukraine, with meetings on the side to recruit billions to his investment funds, Guilfoyle was sent to Greece as the de facto ambassador for liquefied natural gas (LNG). In other words, her job was to shove LNG down the throats of Southeastern and Central European countries. Her refrain was U.S. energy dominance.

A more diplomatic diplomat might have noticed that one country’s dominance means, logically, another’s subservience. But tact was not Guilfoyle’s strong suit, and, according to the Wall Street Journal, another of her gaffes was not-so-subtly telling Greece’s energy minister that the U.S. could change the government of any country it wants.

Guilfoyle denies any intimidation took place, but threatening or forcing regime change for the sake of oil is not far-fetched. (See: Venezuela.)

In Southeast and Central Europe, the U.S. government is pushing something called the Vertical Gas Corridor (VGC), an opaque infrastructure initiative stretching from Greece through Bulgaria, Romania, Hungary, Slovakia, Moldova, and ultimately Ukraine. As stated by the U.S. Energy Association, the VGC “opens access to Europe’s largest underground gas storage system, located in Ukraine.”

Publicly, the U.S. is framing the project as a strategic corridor that strengthens regional energy security and reduces Russian influence. In practice, it is becoming a way to trade dependence on Russia for dependence on the U.S. Greece will be the entry point and collaborator in the plan. U.S. LNG exporters stand to make huge profits, especially when there are high prices, as has been the case during the Iran War.

Why is the U.S. going to the mat for the Vertical Gas Corridor? The fossil fuel industry sees LNG exports as the lifeboat for the sinking ship of the conventional oil industry. For U.S. LNG, as with crude oil, it’s export or die. Those were Ambassador Guilfoyle’s marching orders.

An inconvenient reality for the industry is that market enthusiasm for the VGC appears remarkably weak. Repeated capacity auctions linked to the corridor, in which gas companies bid for the right to use pipelines and other infrastructure, have attracted limited commercial interest. Several auctions failed outright, while others generated only modest bookings concentrated in specific segments of the network.

Infrastructure projects backed by robust commercial fundamentals typically attract customers on their own merits, without the need for lobbying and strong-arming. Massive terminals require long-term contracts, and the U.S. is determined to get both — whether or not it makes any economic sense.

For Greece, the stakes are particularly high.

The country is being positioned as the southern gateway for American LNG entering Southeast Europe. While this positioning promises geopolitical visibility, it also risks tying the Greek economy to fossil fuel infrastructure whose long-term viability remains deeply uncertain. Investments in LNG terminals, pipelines, and associated facilities are dependent on future gas demand that may never materialize as Europe accelerates its clean-energy transition.

At the same time, communities and ecosystems in Greece bear the environmental costs, just as surely as the Texas and Louisiana communities where the methane gas originates. From the Sea of Thrace to other sensitive marine areas, new infrastructure developments are proceeding despite growing concerns over climate impacts, methane emissions, and ecological damage.

author: Shireen Akram-Boshar
title: Hegseth Makes Unannounced Visit to Netanyahu Ahead of Israel’s Elections
content:
The visit came amid discussions between the US and Israel about a renewed assault on Iran.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth made an unannounced visit to Israel on Monday and met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, just eight days before Israel’s upcoming elections.

On Tuesday, in comments to reporters back in the U.S., Hegseth said that he was there “visiting our troops” and “had a chance to talk to the prime minister,” but that he would not discuss the subject of their meeting.

Hegseth met Netanyahu at the Ovda Air Base in southern Israel.

The visit comes amid discussions between the U.S. and Israel about a renewed assault on Iran. According to The Financial Times, Netanyahu had sought to launch a renewed attack on Iran earlier in October, but Trump dissuaded the attack, stating that it should not occur before the U.S. midterm elections. Hegseth, however, is reportedly among the strongest supporters of renewed strikes on Iran.

Hegseth’s visit came a day after Trump endorsed Netanyahu ahead of Israel’s October 27 elections. In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote, “If Israel has the wrong Leader, which would be anyone other than Bibi, America will have to do this work ourselves, and I am not inclined to do so.”

But Trump’s endorsement is unlikely to secure a majority for Netanyahu, who has been in power for 19 years — the longest of any Israeli prime minister — and is now facing a highly contested election. According to polling data, the opposition alliance led by Gadi Eisenkot’s Yashar Party is expected to win the most seats in Israel’s election next Tuesday, though no party is expected to secure a majority.

To form a governing coalition, the party with the most seats will need to form a coalition alongside other, smaller parties. But Eisenkot has stated that he would not form a government with Palestinian parties, particularly the Joint List.

In fact, Eisenkot’s “opposition” alliance diverges very little from Netanyahu’s ruling Likud party, particularly when it comes to Palestinians. Eisenkot has announced that he plans to continue to build Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, and that he is against a Palestinian state. He has even attempted to position himself to the right of Netanyahu on issues like the E1 settlement project, claiming that Netanyahu has been an obstacle to the project. Eisenkot has also stated his aim to expand the Israeli military by compelling Haredi Jews and Palestinian citizens of Israel to enlist in the army.

Tamir Sorek, professor at Penn State University, said in a recent Institute of Middle East Understanding press briefing that the anti-Netanyahu coalition “shares the same fantasy” of eliminating Palestinians, though “they refuse to articulate it.”

While Netanyahu’s Likud is more consistent and adamant in its attempts to exclude Palestinians from the electoral system, opposition parties like Eisenkot’s have also maneuvered to exclude the Palestinian parties, and to prevent Palestinian citizens of Israel — who make up 20 percent of Israel’s population — from voting.

The United Arab List, however, is seen as more acceptable by Israeli political parties than the Joint List, which consists of the more left-wing parties of Hadash (Jabha in Arabic), Ta’al, and Balad. The Arab List became the first Palestinian party to join an Israeli government in 2021, when Naftali Bennett and Yair Lapid briefly removed Netanyahu from power.

But according to Sorek, a significant difference is that anti-Netanyahu voters are more sensitive to international pressure. “The question of who will be the next prime minister of Israel is secondary to whether the international community will press for sanctions on Israel,” Sorek asserted.

author: Tariq Ra’ouf
title: We Beat the Trump Administration in Court. Now We’re Going to the ICC.
content:
I am beginning to see a glimmer of hope that justice will be found for the dozens of family members I have lost in Gaza.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

Over the course of the last three years, my family has lost 49 family members in Gaza. Their bodies were torn apart by shrapnel, crushed by falling buildings, and mutilated by bullets and munitions made and provided by the United States of America. Now, the U.S. is trying to dismantle the International Criminal Court, the only international court that can criminally prosecute U.S. officials for aiding and enabling genocide, by sanctioning the Court and attempting to intimidate anyone, including U.S. citizens, from working with them. So, in response, I joined others to sue this administration in order to take them to the very court they’re trying to destroy.

I’m a Palestinian-American organizer, and I helped establish Taxpayers Alliance Against Genocide (TAAG), which recently partnered with Democracy for the Arab World Now (DAWN) to sue the Trump administration so we can continue much-needed legal and advocacy work. Over the course of over a year, TAAG worked with an international legal team to prepare evidence against top U.S. officials for aiding and enabling the genocide of my people, but up until now, we haven’t been able to submit our evidence to the ICC because of this administration’s attacks and sanctions on the court and its judges.

Thankfully, that will now change after we successfully challenged the Trump administration in court. On October 13 we won a preliminary injunction that blocks this administration from being able to target our groups for working with sanctioned parties, clearing the way for us to proceed to the ICC. For the first time since the genocide started, I am beginning to see a glimmer of hope that justice will be found for the dozens of family members I have lost in Gaza.

Long before the Trump administration sanctioned the entirety of the International Criminal Court (ICC) on October 9, it first enacted Executive Order 14203 in February of 2025. This executive order granted administration officials the ability to sanction foreign nationals for supporting the ICC’s investigations into U.S. and Israeli parties guilty of committing war crimes and their complicity in genocide. Under this Executive Order (EO), the Trump administration also sanctioned leading Palestinian human rights groups al-Haq, al-Mezan, and the Palestinian Center for Human Rights (PCHR), as well as the UN Special Rapporteur for the Human Rights Situation on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, Francesca Albanese, along with other ICC officials.

What many people don’t know is that the EO that allowed the administration to sanction these parties doesn’t only go after foreign nationals, it also makes it a federal offense — punishable by a $1 million fine and/or 20 years in prison — for anyone, including American citizens, who provides or receives a “service” to or from a sanctioned party. This provision of the EO is exactly why TAAG and DAWN took this administration to court: Our lawsuit argued that the EO violates our First Amendment rights as American citizens to speak, associate, and engage in Palestine-related human rights advocacy with these parties. As a founding member of TAAG, I can tell you firsthand how these sanctions have prevented us and organizations like DAWN from being able to continue our work sharing evidence and advocacy ideas with people like Albanese and ICC officials, because the definition of “service” is so broad and undefined — the US can interpret it as being anything that confers a benefit to the recipient.

In an October 9 video of Marco Rubio announcing the actions against the ICC, he tries defending the administration’s actions by calling the ICC a “rogue court,” which the U.S. is “not subject to the jurisdiction of.” But Rubio leaves out a fundamental principle of international law: A country does not have to join the ICC for its nationals to fall within the Court’s jurisdiction.

If a country that is not a State Party to the Rome Statute commits a war crime on the lands of a country that is a state party, the perpetrator of that crime can be investigated. Given that Palestine is a State Party to the Rome Statute, and that Gaza (and the West Bank) are classified as Occupied Palestinian Territories by the United Nations …

author: Unknown
title: Three dead and two missing after flooding in Urmia
content:
At least three people have died in severe flooding in Urmia province in Rojhilat (Eastern Kurdistan). Two others remain missing, while six people have been injured. Heavy rainfall and hailstorms triggered flash floods, particularly in the northern part of the province. The districts of Selmas and Maku have been hardest hit.


According to the provincial Red Crescent Directorate in Urmia, the fatalities occurred in the village of Kaniyan near Selmas, where flooding intensified significantly overnight. Following an extensive search, rescue teams recovered three bodies, including those of a ten-year-old girl and a 63-year-old man. The search for two other missing people is ongoing.


Severe damage to homes and infrastructure


The floodwaters caused extensive damage to homes, roads, and utility infrastructure, particularly in rural areas. According to preliminary assessments, at least 25 houses were flooded and partially destroyed. Eleven vehicles became stranded in floodwaters on connecting roads and near villages.


Search and rescue teams were dispatched to the affected areas. Residents of several flooded villages had to evacuate their homes and were moved to safety.

author: Unknown
title: More than 70 Kurdish families face displacement in Kirkuk
content:
Demolition work for a planned housing development began on Thursday in the Kurdish village of Aliawa in Kirkuk province. More than 70 families face the destruction of their homes and the threat of displacement once again. Residents are protesting the authorities’ actions, pointing out that the land was officially allocated to them years ago.


The village is located on the main road between Kirkuk and Dibis, northwest of the provincial capital. According to local media reports, construction machinery arrived on Thursday and began demolishing shops and commercial premises. More than 70 residential buildings are expected to be demolished in a subsequent phase. Residents say that between 70 and 80 Kurdish families are affected.


‘Now they want to displace us again’


The residents are internally displaced people from Kirkuk who were officially resettled in Aliawa in 2011 and 2012 under Article 140 of the Iraqi Constitution. The constitutional provision calls for the normalization of conditions in disputed territories and the resolution of their political status.


“These plots of land were officially allocated to us by the Commission for Displaced Persons. Now they want to drive us out without any regard for our rights, through political interference. This means we are being displaced once again,” a villager said.


The municipal authorities reportedly offered the affected residents compensation of around two million Iraqi dinars. However, residents consider the amount entirely inadequate.


“This is our village. We grew up here, and now they want to drive us out. Between 70 and 80 houses are threatened with demolition,” another resident said.


The demolition machinery now threatens their entire livelihoods.


Dispute over land rights under Article 140


According to the villagers, an official document calls for the demolition work to be halted due to identified violations. Nevertheless, the relevant authorities are reportedly continuing to pursue the project.


The affected residents also argue that the plots of land remain subject to unresolved property ownership and territorial disputes under Article 140 of the Iraqi Constitution. They maintain that the land must not be allocated to an investment project until its legal status has been definitively clarified.


According to available information, the Kirkuk Investment Commission remains committed to proceeding with the construction project despite these objections.

title: Shengal delegation holds talks at the European Parliament
content:
A diplomatic delegation from Shengal visited the European Parliament in Strasbourg to raise awareness of the situation facing the Yazidi population and the threats to the region. The discussions focused on conditions in Şengal and the challenges confronting its people.


The delegation included Azad Hisên, co-chair of the Shengal People’s Council; Sara Şengalî, a member of the Jineolojî Committee; and Kurdish politician and former Member of the European Parliament Feleknas Uca.


During their visit, the delegation members met with representatives of various political groups and parties in the European Parliament. Those they met included Swedish MEP Jonas Sjöstedt of The Left group, Austrian MEP Andreas Schieder (SPÖ), Galician MEP Ana Miranda Paz, and German MEPs Katrin Langensiepen (Greens), Martin Schirdewan (Die Linke), and Özlem Alev Demirel, also of Die Linke.

author: Jon Queally
title: Netanyahu Orders “Full Lockdown” of Occupied West Bank
content:
Smotrich said the Palestinian Authority should be “dismantled” and called for increased demolition of Palestinian homes.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Friday that he has ordered the Israel Defense Force to “immediately impose a lockdown on Hebron and prepare for a full lockdown of the entire” illegally occupied West Bank following a gun battle that reportedly left two Palestinians dead and at least five Israeli soldiers wounded.

Following an emergency meeting with Israel’s security cabinet and his top military advisors, Netanyahu posted a statement to social media in which he blamed Hamas for the incident and accused the group of “planning a major attack aimed at murdering innocent civilians.”

Netanyahu claimed that “large quantities of weapons and ammunition” had been discovered, but did not offer details about the nature of attack or its alleged planning.

Far-right Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich, who was on the scene of the shooting incident soon after it occurred, warned that “comprehensive military operation” in the occupied West Bank would soon be underway to handle those termed “terrorists.”

Smotrich also said that the Palestinian Authority, which governs the illegally occupied territories, should be “dismantled,” called for large-scale military operations like those executed in Gaza and Lebanon, and for the increased demolition of Palestinian homes.

“There is no alternative to a comprehensive military operation in Judea and Samaria that will lead to the dismantling of the Palestinian Authority, the confiscation of weapons and the elimination of terrorists,” Smotrich said. “Just as in Gaza and Lebanon.”

The order to demolish homes near where Friday’s incident took place, he added, “will begin to be implemented within the next hour, and the demolitions will continue throughout the afternoon.”

Mustafa Barghouti, founder and leader of the Palestinian National Initiative (PNI), was among those warning that what comes next will not be good for the Palestinian people, calling the complete closure of the West Bank “an act of collective punishment.”

Netanyahu, Barghouti said, “declared today that he is planning to carry out the ethnic cleansing of entire neighborhoods in Hebron.”

Such a declaration, he continued, “represents an alarming escalation in Israel’s policies of forced displacement and a flagrant violation of international law and the fundamental rights of the Palestinian people. It must be unequivocally condemned, and the international community must act immediately to prevent the forcible displacement of Palestinian residents and hold those responsible accountable.”

Yariv Oppenheimer, former director of Peace Now and a project director at the Geneva Institute, told Al-Jazeera in a Friday interview that Israeli leaders would now leverage the incident to further tighten their grip on the occupied West Bank, already rife with violence from Israeli settlers and IDF operations in Occupied Palestinian Territories (OPT).

“The Israeli army is getting into the Palestinian cities, the settlers are attacking Palestinians, and the situation is impossible” in the OPT, Oppenheimer explained.

Oppenheimer added that he expected Netanyahu and his cabinet to take advantage of this attack on Israeli soldiers in order to push “more propaganda” to justify the likely violence that is coming from the Israeli government and violent settler factions.

“There will be house demolitions. We will see [a] curfew. We will see more soldiers […] making arrests, and definitely we might see the settlers trying to target Palestinians in revenge for this attack, and trying to take advantage of this situation in order to escalate the situation even more,” Oppenheimer warned.

title: #UnisRetten! – Alarmstufe Rot: Studierende und Lehrende in Österreich protestieren gegen Kürzungen bei den Universitäten sowie den Zukunftsperspektiven
content:
„

Am Donnerstag gehen wir unter dem Motto „Alarmstufe Rot – #UnisRetten!“ gemeinsam auf die Straße – gegen die Unterfinanzierung unserer Universitäten und für ein gutes und gerechtes Studium. Denn statt der mindestens notwendigen 18 Milliarden Euro plant die Bundesregierung für 2028 bis 2030 nur rund 16 Milliarden Euro für die Universitäten ein. Zwei Milliarden Euro fehlen – mit verheerenden Folgen für den Lehrbetrieb, Betreuungs- und Beschäftigungsverhältnisse. Wir haben es satt, dass unsere Zukunft aufs Spiel gesetzt wird! Gemeinsam fordern wir eine abgesicherte und langfristige Finanzierung der öffentlichen Universitäten ein. Denn gute Lehre, Forschung und faire Arbeitsbedingungen gibt es nicht zum Nulltarif. Bis zum 31. Oktober kann die Bundesregierung das Budget noch nachbessern. Wir machen Druck und zeigen gemeinsam: Unsere Zukunft ist nicht verhandelbar!

…“

„

Unter dem Motto „No Cuts! Weder durch Staat noch Rektorat!“,


sind wir heute gemeinsam mit tausenden anderen auf die Straße gegangen! Es war ein starkes Zeichen des Unterbau! Nächstes Treffen: 27.10., 16 uhr votivpark.

@bundesoeh.bsky.social demonstrierten gestern 50.000 Menschen in Wien gegen Kürzungen der Universitätsbudgets. BOKU-Wissenschaftler*innen erzählen, warum sie dabei waren. #UnisRetten @n-roux.bsky.social @boku-ihg.bsky.social

 mit Video


Österreich: Zehntausende bei Studentenprotesten in Wien


„

Neben der Hochschulfinanzierung ging es auch um Arbeitslosigkeit und fehlende berufliche Perspektiven


Die Studentenproteste erreichen Österreich: Unter dem Motto „Alarmstufe Rot – #UnisRetten!“ versammelten sich die Demonstranten am Nachmittag vor der Technischen Universität Wien am Karlsplatz und zogen anschließend durch die Innenstadt. Zu dem Protest hatten die Österreichische Hochschülerinnen- und Hochschülerschaft (ÖH), Universitäten und Hochschulvertretungen aufgerufen. Beteiligt waren neben Studierenden auch Lehrende, Forschende und andere Universitätsbeschäftigte.


Zur Größe der Demonstration gibt es unterschiedliche Angaben. Die ÖH bezifferte die Beteiligung auf rund 50.000 Menschen.  (…)


Ein wesentlicher Teil des Protests galt den sozialen Folgen des Sparkurses für Beschäftigte. Universitäten und Arbeitnehmervertreter befürchten den Abbau zahlreicher Stellen, wobei insbesondere junge Wissenschaftlerinnen und Wissenschaftler betroffen sein könnten. Auf Transparenten wurde unter anderem vor Arbeitslosigkeit und fehlenden beruflichen Perspektiven gewarnt. Auch der Gesundheitsbereich spielte eine Rolle. Universitätskliniken sind zugleich Teil der medizinischen Versorgung. An der Medizinischen Universität Wien wird vor möglichen Auswirkungen der geringeren Finanzierung auf ärztliche Stellen und den Klinikbetrieb gewarnt. Der Betriebsrat am Wiener Allgemeinen Krankenhaus erklärte vor der Demonstration, Einsparungen könnten die Zahl verfügbarer Ärzte und damit auch die Zahl möglicher Operationen reduzieren. Dabei handelt es sich um eine Warnung der Arbeitnehmervertretung, nicht um bereits beschlossene Kürzungen im Krankenhausbetrieb.


Die soziale Dimension zeigte sich zudem an der Zusammensetzung des Protests: Neben Studierenden nahmen Universitätsbeschäftigte aus Wien und anderen Bundesländern teil. Die Gewerkschaft Öffentlicher Dienst organisierte nach Angaben der APA auch die Anreise von Hochschulpersonal sowie Ärztinnen und Ärzten aus anderen Universitätsstädten. (…)


Für die Hochschulen und Studierendenvertretungen ist der Konflikt damit nicht beendet. Die ÖH fordert eine langfristig abgesicherte Finanzierung, die steigende Personal- und Betriebskosten berücksichtigt. Mit der Großdemonstration am Donnerstag verschärfte sich der seit Monaten andauernde Streit über die Frage, welchen Anteil die Universitäten am staatlichen Sparkurs tragen sollen

.“

title: Francia: ante nuevas protestas, Macron prohibe manifestaciones no sindicales, amenaza con el Ejército y limitar internet
content:
Protestas en Marsella, Francia. 17 de octubre de 2026. | THIBAUD MORITZ – AFP


Ante una nueva jornada de protestas convocadas por los Chalecos Amarillos, organizaciones estudiantiles y sectores sindicales para este sábado 24 de octubre, el gobierno de Emmanuel Macron anunció que prepara un operativo represivo reforzado, con la movilización de 70.000 integrantes de las fuerzas de seguridad en todo el país, la participación de militares de la operación antiterrorista Sentinelle y el apoyo de unidades especiales de la Policía y la Gendarmería. También anunció la prohibición de manifestaciones que no estén convocadas por organizaciones sindicales y que no respeten un recorrido previamente informado, y acusó a «grupos de la ultraizquierda» de intentar «hacer caer la República». En tanto, su

 ministro del Interior,

Laurent Nuñez

, propuso evaluar la suspensión temporal de redes sociales como TikTok y Snapchat para frenar la organización popular y la difusión en tiempo real de los movimientos policiales. Mientras, las protestas recrudecen en medio de una crisis socio-económica por las dificultades económicas de los hogares populares, el encarecimiento de la vida, los precios de la energía, los recortes presupuestarios en educación, salud y políticas sociales, y el deterioro de los servicios públicos.

Por ANRed.

La principal novedad del operativo es la participación de efectivos militares para «tareas de apoyo y protección de edificios públicos», con el objetivo de complementar las tareas represivas de policías y gendarmes en el control de las movilizaciones. El gobierno de Macron también anunció la

En paralelo,

Macron anunció la prohibición de las manifestaciones que no estén organizadas por sindicatos, por considerarlas «carentes de legitimidad» y afirmó que la recomendación general es que no haya manifestaciones durante los próximos días.

 A pesar de ello, en París,

el recorrido propuesto por los Chalecos Amarillos fue rechazado, mientras que se autorizó una marcha sindical con un itinerario alternativo

.

Mientras que en otras ciudades, como Lyon y Marsella, se prohibieron las movilizaciones previstas para el sábado

.


Las restricciones se producen en un contexto de creciente conflictividad social:

las protestas del 17 de octubre reunieron a Chalecos Amarillos, estudiantes, trabajadores y otros sectores que reclaman mejoras salariales, medidas frente al encarecimiento de la vida y el freno a los recortes presupuestarios y al deterioro de los servicios públicos.

 Durante la jornada también hubo saqueos, ataques a comercios y edificios públicos y se registraron alrededor de 2.700 detenciones.


Foto: ABDULMONAM EASSA/AFP


En este marco, a las 

protestas estudiantiles iniciadas en septiembre contra la falta de docentes, el deterioro de las escuelas y las dificultades presupuestarias del sistema educativo

, se suma también el movimiento de los

Chalecos Amarillos

, que irrumpió en Francia en 2018 contra el aumento de los combustibles y la pérdida de poder adquisitivo, y ahora vuelve a recuperar protagonismo en una nueva coyuntura de malestar socio- económico generalizado, mientras

buscan ampliar la movilización a trabajadores, jubilados, docentes y otros sectores afectados por el aumento del costo de vida

.

С большим удовлетворением мы объявляем о создании Либертарной Социалистической Организации (OSL), общенациональной анархистской политической организации, которая возникла как результат почти трех десятилетий развития эспецифизма в Бразилии.

OSL была основана 9 июля этого (2023) года в Сан-Паулу в результате первой сессии совместного съезда, проведенного активистами Федерации Анархистов Рио-де-Жанейро (FARJ), Анархистской организации либертарного социализма (OASL, Сан-Паулу), Rusga Libertária (Мату Гроссу) и Коллектива народных анархистов Минас-Жерайс (COMPA), а также активистами из других регионов Бразилии. Организации, ограниченные Бразильскими Штатами, распускаются, и мы приступаем к созданию единой анархистской политической организации, которая будет охватывать все регионы Бразилии.

Мы придерживаемся организационного дуализма, то есть участия анархистов в народных движениях (социальный уровень) и в специфически политических организациях (политический уровень). На социальном уровне мы близки к историческим формам революционного синдикализма; на политическом уровне к историческим формам цельных и программно-ориентированных организаций: платформизма и эспецифизма.

В OSL мы стремимся вкладывать силы в построение и в регулярное и постоянное участие в народных движениях, имея четкую и определенную программу, чтобы сформировать реальную политическую силу, которая сможет сделать анархизм снова инструментом вовлечения в борьбу угнетенных классов. Мы также выступаем за отказ от принципизма, конкретно подходя к реальности, действуя как «рыба в воде» среди рабочего класса. Кроме того, мы предлагаем окончательно отказаться от Синтеза в пользу программа-ориентированной организационной позиции, с теоретическим, идеологическим и практическим единством, с коллективной ответственностью и дисциплиной.

Мы с большим оптимизмом смотрим на этот новый этап и уверены, что OSL будет способствовать продвижению организованного анархизма и народной борьбы на территории Бразилии!

title: „Die Kürzungen sind unerträglich“: Ein breites Bündnis hat den Kampf zur Verteidigung des öffentlichen Bildungswesens in Madrid aufgenommen
content:
Dossier


„

Mehr als 20 Organisationen haben sich zusammengeschlossen, um zu versuchen, das, was sie als Plan der Regionalregierung zur Dekapitalisierung des öffentlichen Bildungswesens zugunsten des privaten Bildungswesens ansehen, rückgängig zu machen. Mit dem Ruf „Bildungsqualität oder unbefristeter Streik“ haben Tausende von Menschen heute Morgen im Zentrum der Hauptstadt mehr Mittel für die öffentliche Bildung in Madrid gefordert. An der von mehr als 20 Organisationen, darunter Gewerkschaften, Universitätsversammlungen und verschiedene soziale Gruppen, organisierten Demonstration nahmen Vertreter und konkrete Forderungen aus allen Bildungsbereichen, von den 0- bis 3-Jährigen bis zu den Studenten und der Berufsausbildung, sowie politische Parteien teil. Nach Angaben der Organisatoren nahmen etwa 120.000 Menschen an der Demonstration teil

…“ So beginnt der umfangreiche span.

Artikel von Guillermo Martínez vom 23. Februar 2025 in elDiario.es


 (maschinenübersetzt) mit schönen Fotos der Transparente – siehe mehr Infos:


Am 20. Oktober, dem 5. Tag des unbefristeten Bildungsstreiks in Madrid überfluteten die Lehrkräfte die Straßen – Rufe an die Polizei wie „Nicht schlagen!“ blieben ungehört


Die Region, die am wenigsten in Bildung investiert und am stärksten segregiert: Die Gründe für einen Streik in Madrid


„

Die Lehrkräfte Madrids zeigen erneut ihre Stärke, indem sie am fünften Streiktag die Straßen von der Regierungsdelegation bis zum Bildungsministerium überfluten – nachdem es am Montag bei einer Veranstaltung, an der Ayuso teilnahm, zu Zusammenstößen gekommen war.


Mit Lichtern und Taschenlampen, Rufen wie „Nicht schlagen!“ und Transparenten mit Aufschriften wie „Ayuso besiegen“ hat eine Flut von Lehrkräften am Dienstag, dem 20. Oktober, dem fünften Tag des Bildungsstreiks in der Autonomen Gemeinschaft Madrid, erneut die Straßen überschwemmt. Diesmal führte der Marsch von der Regierungsdelegation bis zum Bildungsministerium – ein Eilaufruf nach den Polizeieinsätzen am Montag, bei denen eine spontane Kundgebung vor der Madrider Handelskammer, wo die Präsidentin Isabel Díaz Ayuso (Partido Popular) an einer Veranstaltung teilnahm, gewaltsam aufgelöst wurde.


Die Organisatoren prangern an, dass es bei der Bildung einer Sicherheitskette für den Abzug der Präsidentin zu Verletzten gekommen sei und dass bei einer friedlichen Demonstration unverhältnismäßige Gewalt angewendet worden sei. Die Kundgebung, die vor dem Bildungsministerium begann und in der Calle del Príncipe endete, war ein Versuch, Aufmerksamkeit zu erregen, nachdem sich die Regionalregierung geweigert hatte, mit dem Streikkomitee zu verhandeln.


Zuvor hatte die Bildungsministerin Mercedes Zarzalejo einen Besuch in der öffentlichen Berufsschule „IFP Antonio Palacios“ geplant. „Das gemischte Streikkomitee begab sich zur Schule, um sie zu Verhandlungen aufzufordern. Die Ministerin entschied sich, dieser Veranstaltung fernzubleiben“, erklärt Betty de Lara García, Sprecherin der Abteilung für öffentliches Bildungswesen der CNT in der Autonomen Gemeinschaft Madrid, einer der Gewerkschaften, die gemeinsam mit CGT, UGT, CCOO, STEM, Solidaridad Obrera und Organisationen wie Menos Lectivas, Plataforma Laboral por las Escuelas Infantiles (PLEI) oder Educación Especial Digna zum Streik aufgerufen hatten. (…)


Die Fakten zum Streik


Hintergrund ist ein Streik, der durch die Lage des Bildungswesens in der Autonomen Gemeinschaft Madrid ausgelöst wurde. Laut dem staatlichen Bildungsindikatorensystem von 2026 gibt Madrid 6.502 Euro pro Schüler (ohne Hochschulstudenten) aus – das ist der niedrigste Wert im gesamten Staat und liegt weit unter dem nationalen Durchschnitt von 7.943 Euro. Weit davon entfernt liegen das Baskenland mit 12.484 Euro und Navarra mit 9.991 Euro. Dennoch ist Madrid laut Daten des INE die Region mit dem höchsten BIP. Im Jahr 2025 belief sich dieser Wert auf 47.220 Euro pro Einwohner

…“ span.

title: Brazil Elections: How AI, Meta and Evangelicals Could Sway the Presidential Race for Bolsonaro
content:
Brazilian voters are heading to the polls on Sunday for the presidential runoff between incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and far-right Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, with polls showing a tight race that will decide whether Brazil remains led by the left or joins the right-wing surge across Latin America.


According to

The Intercept Brasil

, Bolsonaro’s campaign paid 600,000 Brazilian reais (about $119,000

USD

) to a U.S. company, Elytron, that specializes in election manipulation, including through online disinformation and “psychological warfare techniques” to undermine opponents.


Reporter Laís Martins says that while it’s not clear whether or how the Bolsonaro campaign used Elytron’s services, it adds to suspicion of U.S. interference in the election, including Meta’s restrictions on President Lula’s social media profiles. “We’ve seen evidence pile up that something is not right, that this playing field is not equal,” says Martins.

author: Miriam Lafontaine
title: Man dies after being struck by vehicle near Ullivik health centre
content:
A 69-year-old man is dead after being struck by a driver near the Ullivik health centre in Dorval, Que., on Tuesday.


The incident happened near the health centre after a driver turned from Orly Avenue onto Michel-Jasmin Avenue, said Montreal police spokesperson Raphaël Bergeron in an interview with Nunatsiaq News.


On Wednesday, Ullivik director Rita Novalinga, Inuulitsivik Health Centre executive director Sarah Beaulne and Nunavik Regional Board of Health and Social Services executive director Jennifer Munick-Watkins issued a statement about “the tragic death of a member of our community last night in Dorval.”


“As a community, we mourn this loss together,” the statement reads. “Our thoughts and hearts are with the family, loved ones, and the entire Inukjuak community during this difficult time.”


The statement did not provide any more details about the incident, and NRBHSS, which issued the statement, did not immediately respond to a request for comment.


Other fatal collisions have happened near the health centre. In 2022, two Inuit women, in two separate incidents, were killed by drivers on nearby Highway 520.

author: Mag
title: Studierendenproteste in Griechenland richten sich gemeinsam mit Gewerkschaften gegen Privatisierung der Bildung und Lebenshaltungskosten
content:
„

Eine Welle von Schüler- und Studentenprotesten, die in mehreren europäischen Ländern zu beobachten ist, erreicht auch Griechenland. Hier gehen Studenten angesichts hoher Mietkosten und von Kosteneinsparungen bei den staatlichen Universitäten auf die Barrikaden. Vor diesem Hintergrund wollen sie am Dienstag (20.10.) in Zelten am Athener Syntagma-Platz vor dem Parlament campieren. Damit wolle man symbolisch über die angespannte Lage bei Studentenwohnungen hinweisen. (…) Kritisiert wird außerdem, dass die Universitätsgebäude an erheblichen Mängeln bei der Infrastruktur, der Heizung und der Instandhaltung leiden würden.

Gleichzeitig protestieren die Studenten auch gegen die Gründung privater Universitäten. Dies sei nicht zuletzt mit einer gleichzeitigen Vernachlässigung der staatlichen Hochschulen verbunden

…“

Artikel von Elisa Hübel vom 20. Oktober 2026 in der Griechenland Zeitung


 („Studentenproteste erreichen Griechenland“) – siehe auch Aufrufe der Gewerkschaften und Berichte:


Die Arbeitnehmer, ihre Kinder und die Rentner haben ihre Stimme erhoben!


„

Arbeitnehmer, Studenten, Schüler und Rentner bildeten in allen Städten Griechenlands eine reißende Welle des Protests und überwanden damit das Klima der Einschüchterung, das die Regierung zu schaffen versuchte, um dies zu verhindern. Angesichts der Versuche, die Mobilisierungen zu untergraben und zu diffamieren, sowie der Panikmache, dass sie Chaos auslösen würden, demonstrierten Zehntausende Menschen und Jugendliche gegen das Chaos, das die Politik der Regierung in ihrem Leben verursacht.


Zehntausende Lehrkräfte, Lehrer und Professoren beteiligten sich an dem von ihren Verbänden ausgerufenen Streik und bildeten riesige Blöcke bei den groß angelegten Kundgebungen aller Bildungsbereiche. Hunderte von Schulen blieben geschlossen. Es war einer der größten Streiks der letzten Jahre im Bildungswesen.


Die große Beteiligung an der Arbeitsniederlegung der A.D.E.D.Y., die am Mittwoch, 21. Oktober 2026, von 11:00 Uhr bis zum Ende der Schicht, sowie die kämpferische und massive Präsenz der Beamten bei den heutigen Mobilisierungen, sendeten eine deutliche Botschaft des Widerstands und der Forderungen. Sie haben bewiesen, dass die Arbeiterbewegung und die Kämpfe der Jugend den wahren Gegner der Regierung darstellen.


Ihre Forderungen vereinten sich zu einer gemeinsamen Front gegen die Politik, die Bildung und Gesundheit weiter kommerzialisiert, Löhne und Renten drückt, Arbeitnehmerrechte untergräbt und die Bildungsbedürfnisse unserer Kinder vernachlässigt.


Der Slogan „Von Griechenland bis Frankreich kämpfen wir für öffentliche und kostenlose Bildung“ hallte lautstark durch ganz Europa! Es erreichte die Jugend, die sich erhebt und das Recht einfordert, in Würde zu leben, sich weiterzubilden und auf eine bessere Zukunft zu hoffen.


Ebenso laut war die Stimme der Krankenhausärzte und Rentner gegen die eingefrorenen Gehälter, gegen das unterbesetzte und unterfinanzierte öffentliche Gesundheitssystem sowie gegen eine Politik, die das Gesundheitspersonal bis zur Erschöpfung treibt, öffentliche Krankenhäuser in Unternehmen verwandelt und Patienten als Kunden behandelt.


Die heutige Massenbeteiligung erfüllt uns mit Optimismus und Kraft. Sie bestätigt, dass wir mit starken Verbänden, Einheit und Koordination unsere Kämpfe stärken können. Nichts wird geschenkt, Errungenschaften werden durch kollektives Eintreten und kämpferisches Handeln errungen.


Wir rufen jeden Verband und alle Gewerkschaften dazu auf, eine Vorreiterrolle beim Aufbau einer massiven und entschlossenen Bewegung zu übernehmen. Um die Organisation und das Durchsetzen unserer Forderungen an jedem Arbeitsplatz zu stärken. In einer Zeit, in der Arbeitnehmer*innen und junge Menschen in vielen europäischen Ländern gegen den Krieg auf die Straße gehen und für Bildung, Wohnraum und ein Leben mit Rechten kämpfen, vereinen wir unsere Stimmen. Ohne zu warten und ohne uns Illusionen über Retter zu machen, stützen wir uns auf unsere eigenen Kräfte und gehen voran, indem wir unsere Aktionen intensivieren, mit Optimismus und Beharrlichkeit auf den Streik am 25. November zu, der neue Schritte in der Organisation des Gegenangriffs der Arbeiter und des Volkes einläuten kann

.“ griech.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Ohio Governor's Race: Trump Backs Ramaswamy Ad Siding with Opponent's Indicted Childhood Rapist
content:
President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance have both defended Ohio gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy after his campaign released a TV ad that appears to accuse Democratic nominee Amy Acton of lying about being sexually abused as a child. Acton’s stepfather was indicted in 1978 on charges of sexually assaulting her when she was between 10 and 12 years old, though he fled before he could be convicted. Acton’s mother, who lost custody of her two children, sided with her husband and remained with him as a fugitive until his death in 2004. In the controversial campaign ad, the elderly Donna Arthur says her daughter Amy has “lied her entire life” and can’t be trusted as governor, which has been widely interpreted as casting doubt on what Acton has said about being abused as a minor.


“Vivek Ramaswamy is now using that personal trauma as an effort to exploit what she went through and win this race,” says Abby Vesoulis, a reporter for

Mother Jones

. “He’s currently polling beneath Amy Acton, which shows, I think, that this ad is a desperate attempt to somehow pull off a victory despite poor odds.”


Vesoulis says outrage over the ad, even among Republican voters, is tied to simmering anger about how the Trump administration has handled the Epstein files. She also discusses abuse allegations against Ohio Republican Congressmember Max Miller, who is running for reelection.

author: Unknown
title: “Democratic Integration Conference” to be held in Zurich
content:
The Kurdish Association for Social Research (Akademî Kurd) will hold a conference titled “Democratic Integration” tomorrow, Saturday 24 October, in Zurich. The conference will examine the concept of democratic integration from various perspectives within the framework of the Manifesto for a Democratic Communal Society put forward by Abdullah Öcalan.


The conference will bring together academics, politicians, lawyers, and researchers to discuss the theoretical foundations of democratic integration, as well as its social, political, and cultural dimensions. Legal reforms and a democratic communal economy will also be among the main topics of discussion, particularly in relation to a democratic solution to the Kurdish question.


The conference will begin at 9:15 a.m. with the first session, titled “The Conceptual and Theoretical Framework of Democratic Integration.” Running until 10:45 a.m., the session will feature Kurdish politician Çetin Arkaş and sociologist, academic, and author Nazan Üstündağ.


Political, sociological and cultural dimensions to be discussed


The conference’s second session, scheduled for 11 a.m. to 1 p.m., will focus on “The Political, Sociological, and Cultural Dimensions of Democratic Integration.”


Speakers will include Mazlum Abdi, an adviser to the Syrian presidency; Engin Sustam, a sociologist from Paris 8 University; Zilan Diyar, a member of TJK-E; and Derya Arslan, a member of the Central Executive Board of the DEM Party.


The session will discuss the implications of democratic integration for social and political life, as well as the possibilities for different social groups to coexist on a democratic basis.


The legal dimension of the Kurdish question


The conference’s third session, scheduled for 1:30 p.m. to 3 p.m., will be titled “The Legal Dimension of Democratic Integration and a Solution for All Kurds.”


The speakers will be lawyer Özgür Erol, a member of the Imrali delegation, and lawyer Hüsnü Yılmaz. The session will examine the legal dimension of democratic integration and discuss legal frameworks and democratic guarantees in the context of resolving the Kurdish question.


The final session, scheduled for 3:15 p.m. to 5 p.m., will focus on “Democratic Integration and the Democratic Communal Economy.”


Researcher and economist Ahmet Pelda and sociologist and anthropologist Neşe Özgen will speak at the session, which will examine the economic dimension of democratic integration and the concept of a democratic communal economy.


The conference will take place at Kirchgemeindehaus Wiedikon, Bühlstrasse 9/11, 8055 Zurich.

author: Unknown
title: Imprisoned PKK members commemorate martyrs and reaffirm commitment to peace
content:
PKK prisoners incarcerated in Turkey issued a joint statement commemorating those who lost their lives in the Kurdish freedom struggle and reaffirming their determination to carry forward their legacy through the Peace and Democratic Society Process. In the statement released by Deniz Kaya, they emphasized that remembering the martyrs is inseparably linked to the pursuit of a democratic resolution to the Kurdish question.


The statement followed the publication of the identities of members of the Kurdish freedom movement who lost their lives at different times and in various areas of resistance. The prisoners paid tribute to their fallen comrades and all those who lost their lives in the struggle for freedom and democracy.


“The martyrs embody the historical memory of our struggle, its ideological core, and the deepest truth of our pursuit of freedom,” the statement said.


It added that each individual’s life and struggle formed part of the collective aspiration for a free life, the determination to resist, and the hope for a democratic future.


Embedding peace in society


The statement underlined that: "Commemoration means not only keeping the past alive in collective memory but also taking responsibility for the future. Honoring the martyrs must be reflected in political attitudes, the assumption of social responsibility, and organizational renewal."


“We believe that the most meaningful response to the goals, hopes, and dreams of our fallen comrades is to embed peace in society, advance a democratic solution, and build a shared life for our peoples based on equality and freedom,” the prisoners declared.


The legacy of the martyrs, they added, forms a bridge between the past and the future while preserving the memory of the struggle for freedom and democracy.


Determination to continue the struggle


The imprisoned PKK members extended their condolences to Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan, the families of the martyrs, and the Kurdish people. They also reaffirmed their determination to continue pursuing the political goals of their deceased comrades.


“We are determined to connect the unfulfilled dreams of our fallen comrades with a future in which peace, democracy, and a free life have become a reality,” the statement concluded.


“We promise to keep their memory alive in our hearts and minds and their goals alive in our struggle. We will continue our efforts to fulfill their hopes through the building of a democratic society.”

author: Omar Refaat
title: The caretakers
content:
Cairo – Summer 2025


Between the neck and the sword  


Yet, we go on, somehow, somewhen, somewhere. 


What’s making the unbearable bearable then? Who’s trying to make the fractured whole, the  paralysis somehow silently fruitful? Who’s trying to make the harshness of fate, hard not to adore and hard not to loathe fate, a feather more healthy? Who’s trying to reframe, to salvage, our maimed context on the run? 


Who, unsung, has been taking care of some of us in this beautiful brutal Cairo the past few, calamitous years? 


I looked around me and asked myself. 


What is love, in other words, and how is it being dispensed in the moonless waves of this incomprehensible grief?


What does love look like in the mutilated, public square now, mauled by this hellish, false reality shoved down our parched throats? What mermaid shapes is it taking in the fissures? In the plague of small, deranged men let loose on us, where does love drip, bloom calmly, lucidly, on its own? And we’re not even seeing it in the blur of our unfathomable resignation. Where do we, the afflicted of this earth, hold on, and who do we hold on to, hold dear, in this gale? What subtle kinds of repair are plugging the leak of meaning, the love-deficit, that won’t stop gushing with a grain of sand? Where is deliverance stealthily planting its seeds in abeyance, under the sign of this senseless darkness? 


Where are some of the unhailed glimmers of “capacious care” and “care commons,” the light river goddess of the drops of thankless sweat on which Capital, and State, are freeriding shamelessly, washing their hands of the very things which reproduce society on their behalf. 


And I have searched, dazed and yearning and lacerated, for the secret of heaven in the folds of this mortal coil, from mountaintops and through the gutter, and all I could find comes down to three things: love, beauty, art. 


Give us the holiest of trinities straight up in one go, and you are my savior, my friend. 


When the lab refuses capture 


How does urban space (which is shaped by political, economic, social, cultural forces operating in any given conjuncture and is never neutral or apolitical or absolute) refuse, intervene in, soar out of, the necropolis and kiss a thousand dancing stars back down upon the disquiet? How does it embrace difference and multiplicity and adversity and our glorious polyversality? Where is it trying to make the unconscious conscious, that misty bridge between the seen and the unseen and the yet-to-be-seen, experimenting with convivial ways of making life and sense and community, searching up the latent prospects of our intersubjective unfoldings and enfoldings on our own terms, new old tonalities of being and desiring and shaping and dreaming and self-forgetting together? 


Who are some of the people planning and improvising open-endedly, producing mini DIY sites of coping in the crannies of this evermore anguished, evermore giving, metropolis, carving times-out-of-time and spaces-out-of-space, commoning and instituting otherwise?

Whose unpaid and/or severely devalued labor, physical, cognitive, immaterial, emotional labor, is keeping alive the alternative / independent art spaces and festivals and makeshift underground leftfield dancefloors in the heart of our crumbling city, those rare and endangered encounters and relational

thinking and common feeling and mutual tending and collective looking and non-curricular, anti-canonical asking and radical study liminalities,

against fiercely hostile conditions of near total defeat?

 Why and how are they doing this? How is the why inflecting their how?


What does it mean to nurse the jilted and the jaded, the leftovers, to smell a festering lesion and take responsibility for doing something about it? How do we not take this scarce bounty, this frail “right to the city,” right to unruly thought, right to marvel, right to fecund getting-together and, as obscene as it sounds, right to shared joy, that all-too-fleeting feeling of alignment with the cosmos, in this bleak for granted? How is it changing them, this kind of overspending of self? What are they prefiguring and foreshadowing, these “liminal blossoms” on the borders of joint becoming, those who toil for others to twinkle, for a chance for us to understand our interdependence, to discover untouched continents in each other’s eyes, to savor and have empathy for and be vulnerable, be immortal for a second, with each other, to soften our …

title: Flávio Bolsonaro está nu como o rei da fábula
content:
Quer receber os textos desta coluna em primeira mão no seu e-mail? Assine a Newsletter da Pública, enviada sempre às sextas-feiras, 8h. Para receber as próximas edições,

inscreva-se aqui

.


O mais bonito foi ver as manifestações nas ruas, algumas com centenas de milhares de pessoas, como a que tomou doze quarteirões da Av. Paulista e coloriu Copacabana de ponta a ponta. Foi a nossa vez de vestir o verde amarelo (com ou sem estrelinhas) e sair em defesa do nosso país, ameaçado por uma extrema direita com uma tentativa golpista no currículo e agora fortalecida pelo apoio subalterno dos Bolsonaro aos planos expansionistas de Donald Trump.


A presença maciça da juventude — da UNE aos

fandoms

 — nos atos que se repetiram em pelo menos 80 cidades brasileiras nesse 2º turno, trouxe um sopro de renovação política quase inesperado em uma campanha pelo quarto mandato de um presidente de 80 anos de idade. Energia que se transformou em eficiência inédita da centro-esquerda nas redes sociais, apesar das evidências concretas de jogo sujo por parte das

Big Techs

 e do

TSE

 de Nunes Marques e André Mendonça para prejudicar a campanha de Lula.


Isso sem falar no episódio lamentável do governo Tarcísio de Freitas, com a PM repetindo um artifício usado na véspera do 2º turno da primeira eleição presidencial direta depois da ditadura — se em 1989, vestiu os sequestradores de Abílio Diniz com as camisetas do PT para exibir para a imprensa dias antes do pleito; agora faz o

mesmo

 com suspeitos de tráfico de drogas detidos e fotografados ostentando camisetas novas com dizeres da campanha de Lula e a sigla da associação dos professores. 


Mas, ao contrário das milícias digitais da extrema direita, a campanha da centro-esquerda nas redes, privilegiou a empatia – foram muitos os posts autocríticos sobre a arrogância ou falta de compreensão na comunicação com a direita – e se apoiou em fatos reais para apontar o risco da candidatura de extrema direita à soberania, à democracia, aos direitos constitucionais e às conquistas sociais, a mais recente delas, o fim da jornada 6×1. Tanto que o “dá um google” se tornou argumento para a campanha de Lula.


Mas essas pautas passaram longe ou foram deturpadas em manchetes de jornais e escaladas da TV durante todo o 1º turno

, quando as empresas jornalísticas se ocuparam de vazamentos seletivos de processos que estavam com o ministro André Mendonça, engajado na campanha de Flávio, e de críticas ao governo Lula até em relação a medidas de óbvio interesse público, como a proibição das bets (essa prejudicial aos seus negócios).


Enquanto isso,

o jornalismo independente se unia na investigação da interferência de Trump e das Big Techs

title: Borsada son 18 yılın en uzun düşüşü
content:
Borsa İstanbul’da satış baskısı sürüyor. BIST 100 endeksi, gün içinde yüzde 2’yi aşan kayıpla 10 bin 963 puana kadar geriledi. Günün ilk yarısında yüzde 2,62 düşüşle 10 bin 926,54 puana inen endeks, 5 Aralık 2025’ten bu yana en düşük seviyesini test etti.

Endeksin bu haftayı da ekside tamamlaması durumunda art arda altı haftalık düşüş yaşanacak. Bu, kaynak metindeki verilere göre Şubat 2008’den bu yana görülen en uzun haftalık kayıp serisi olacak.

Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası’nın (TCMB) 22 Ekim’de politika faizini 100 baz puan indirerek yüzde 36’ya çekmesi, borsadaki düşüşü tersine çevirmedi.

Faiz indirimlerinin şirketlerin finansman maliyetlerini azaltarak hisse değerlemelerini destekleyebileceği beklentisine rağmen endekste satış baskısı sürdü. Piyasalardaki negatif seyir, faiz kararının borsa üzerindeki etkisinin sınırlı kaldığına işaret etti.

Borsadaki düşüş sürerken TBMM Genel Kurulu'nda, tasfiyesine karar verilen bazı yatırım fonlarına ilişkin düzenlemeler içeren kanun teklifi kabul edildi.

Düzenlemeye göre, kapsam dahilindeki fonlarla bağlantılı usulsüzlük soruşturmalarında Ceza Muhakemesi Kanunu hükümleri doğrultusunda el koyma kararı alınabilecek. El koyma ve müsadere süreçleri dışında kalan durumlarda fonların tasfiye denetimini Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK) yürütecek.

SPK, oluşan zararları ve bu zararlardan sorumlu olduğu değerlendirilen kişi veya kurumları tespit ederek Tasarruf Mevduatı Sigorta Fonuna (TMSF) bildirecek. Geri kazanım hesaplarında toplanan tutarlar, yasal masraflar düşüldükten sonra tasfiye işlemleri için TMSF’ye aktarılacak.

title: MESEM’de öğrencilere sahte staj organize ederek dolandırıcılık yapan 12 kişi tutuklandı
content:
Mersin'de yürütülen soruşturma kapsamında, bazı MESEM’lerde usulsüzlük yapıldığı iddiaları üzerine operasyon yapıldı. Aralarında eski okul müdürlerinin de bulunduğu şüphelilerin, sahte staj organizasyonlarıyla dolandırıcılık yaptığı ve rüşvet aldığı belirlendi.

Soruşturma dosyasında yer alan bilgilere göre, staj belgeleri düzenlenen öğrencilerin kağıt üstünde gösterildikleri iş yerlerinde fiilen staja gitmediği tespit edildi. Bu yöntemle toplam 36 milyon 244 bin 715 lira kamu zararına neden olunduğu, bunun yanı sıra 8 milyon 749 bin lira nakit para, iki dizüstü bilgisayar ve iki renkli yazıcının rüşvet olarak alındığı öne sürüldü.

Yürütülen çalışmalar sonucunda 45 şüphelinin kimliği saptandı. Şüphelilerden birinin hayatını kaybettiği, ikisinin ise başka suçlardan cezaevinde bulunduğu belirlendi.

Ekipler tarafından 21 Ekim’de 5 ilde gerçekleştirilen eş zamanlı baskınlarda 39 kişi gözaltına alındı. Adreslerinde bulunamayan diğer kişilerin yakalanması için çalışmaların sürdüğü bildirildi. Emniyetteki işlemlerinin ardından adliyeye sevk edilen şüphelilerden 12’si çıkarıldıkları hakimlikçe tutuklanırken, diğer şüpheliler adli kontrol şartıyla serbest bırakıldı.

author: anred
title: La otra cara de Vaca Muerta: cierran escuela por contaminación
content:
Foto: Martín Álvarez Mullally


En la provincia de Neuquén, la Escuela Primaria N°291 ubicada en Aguada Toledo, dentro de Loma La Lata–Sierra Barrosa, fue inhabilitada por contaminación. La comunidad escolar  está siendo trasladada sin información. Después de dos meses sin clases, el Consejo Provincial de Educación resolvió mantener el edificio cerrado hasta fines de febrero, mientras YPF debe realizar un plan de remediación. A tan solo 1100 metros del edificio escolar funciona una de las fuentes de emisiones de metano más importantes a nivel global según lo determinó el seguimiento realizado por el Observatorio Internacional de Emisiones del Metano del Programa de Naciones Unidas para el Ambiente (PNUMA).

Por Leonora Jáuregui Nicolet (OPSur) y María Marta Di Paola (Asociación Argentina de Abogados/as Ambientalistas/CAJE).


La Escuela Primaria N°291 de Aguada Toledo está cerrada desde que terminaron las vacaciones de invierno, hace casi dos meses. La vuelta del receso coincidió con un temporal que complicó el camino en un sector particularmente deteriorado. Es el tramo en el que el tránsito de camiones formó un zanjón que acumula agua cuando  llueve y no permite que el transporte escolar pase con seguridad. El 18 de agosto, con el acceso en mejores condiciones, el edificio se quedó sin gas.


Janet Alveal es la directora de esta escuela rural que corresponde al Distrito Escolar II de Cutral Có y Plaza Huincul. En el transcurso de estas semanas, Alveal difundió un comunicado sobre el estado de situación y la necesidad de recibir respuestas institucionales: “Esta falta de servicio (de gas) afecta el funcionamiento cotidiano de una escuela de jornada completa, por lo que se han realizado las gestiones correspondientes para intentar obtener una solución”.


Durante casi dos meses, la única explicación que dio el Consejo Provincial de Educación fue que en la escuela había pérdidas porque el gas se consumía más rápido. La comunidad escolar de Aguada Toledo realizó una serie de reclamos públicos en articulación con la Asociación de Trabajadorxs de la Educación del Neuquén (ATEN) y lograron que los reciba Soledad Martínez, Ministra de Educación, en la sede principal del Consejo, en la ciudad de Neuquén.


El lunes 21 de septiembre, luego de diez semanas sin clases, la responsable de educación de la provincia se reunió con la comunidad escolar y les comunicó que la escuela va a permanecer cerrada hasta fines de febrero por cuestiones de sanidad ambiental que eligió no explicar. Anticipó la decisión de trasladar las clases a Challacó, es decir, 30 km más lejos por un camino de ripio siempre en malas condiciones.


El día viernes 25 de septiembre, las autoridades de la escuela recibieron una nota de comunicación interna entre autoridades educativas de la provincia donde se informa la inhabilitación transitoria del establecimiento entre octubre de este año y febrero del próximo año. La inhabilitación se dispuso “en relación con las actuaciones llevadas adelante por la Secretaría de Ambiente y Recursos Naturales respecto de la situación ambiental existente en las inmediaciones de la Escuela Primaria N.º 291 de Aguada Toledo”, con el objetivo de resguardar a la comunidad educativa frente a las tareas de mitigación que debe realizar la empresa YPF. Según informa la nota, la Secretaría de Ambiente derivó a YPF la realización del estudio y monitoreo de la calidad del aire, delegando la responsabilidad técnica y socioambiental al sector empresarial.

title: Eski Türkiye Sigorta Genel Müdürü'ne yöneltilen suçlamalar ortaya çıktı: Tera grubundan 1 milyon dolar elden para almak
content:
Yürütülen fon soruşturmasında yeni bir gelişme yaşandı. Daha önce gözaltına alınıp adli kontrol şartıyla serbest bırakılan eski Türkiye Sigorta ve Türkiye Hayat Emeklilik Genel Müdürü Taha Çakmak, yeniden gözaltına alındı. Çakmak’ın bir hafta önce, 15 Ekim 2026 tarihi itibarıyla görevinden istifa ettiği açıklanmıştı.

Adli kaynaklardan edinilen bilgilere göre soruşturma kapsamında Taha Çakmak’a, fon soruşturmaları çerçevesinde Türkiye Sigorta'ya ait mevduatlardan Tera fonlarına yüksek hacimli para giriş işlemleri yapılarak kar elde edilmesi, fona giriş sağlanan mevduat karşılığında Tera grubuna ait hisseler üzerinde şahsi alım işlemleri gerçekleştirilmesi, G….ürk isimli hisseye Tera grubunun giriş yapması hususunda yönetici olduğu kurumun mevduatlarını yatırma sözü verilmesi ve bu durumun şart koşulması ile G….ürk hissesi ve Tera grubuna ait diğer hisseler üzerinden menfaat temin edilmesi suçlamaları yöneltildi. Öte yandan, 21 Ekim 2026 tarihinde soruşturma kapsamında alınan beyanlarda, Türkiye Sigorta'nın fona yatırımı karşılığında Tera grubundan 1 milyon dolar elden para alındığı öne sürüldü. NTV Muhabiri Özgür Yılmaz da Çakmak'ın bu parayı doğrudan elden aldığının iddia edildiğini aktardı.

Çakmak, geçen hafta Türkiye Sigorta ve Türkiye Hayat Emeklilik'teki genel müdürlük görevinden istifa etmişti. Türkiye Sigorta AŞ tarafından Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) yapılan açıklamada, "Şirketimiz Genel Müdürü Taha Çakmak, 15 Ekim 2026 tarihi itibarıyla görevinden istifa etmiştir. Genel Müdürlük görevine henüz atama yapılmamış olup, bu konuda bir gelişme olması durumunda kamuoyuyla paylaşılacaktır" denilmişti.

1981 yılında Elazığ'da doğan Taha Çakmak, Hacettepe Üniversitesi İktisadi ve İdari Bilimler Fakültesi İngilizce İşletme Bölümü’nden mezun oldu. Kariyerine 2004 yılında denetçi olarak başlayan Çakmak, 2005-2019 yılları arasında Ziraat Bankası bünyesinde çeşitli yöneticilik görevlerinde bulundu. 2019 yılında Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı Özelleştirme İdaresi Başkanlığında daire başkanlığı yapan Çakmak, aynı yıl Bankacılık Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu (BDDK) Başkan Yardımcılığına getirildi. 2021 yılında Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası (TCMB) Başkan Yardımcılığına atanan Çakmak, Temmuz 2023'te bu görevden alındı. Çakmak, 3 Ağustos 2023'te Atilla Benli'nin yerine Türkiye Sigorta ve Türkiye Hayat Emeklilik Genel Müdürü olarak atanmış ve aynı zamanda Yönetim Kurulu Başkan Vekilliği görevini üstlenmişti.
